verdict.rationale: Gazebo users author and run worlds as SDFormat files they edit directly, and the example worlds and Fuel model snippets can be freely copied into their own SDF files, so core simulation assets live in a portable, text-based format rather than a proprietary store. The pack says nothing about exporting the full body of user data, such as simulation logs, recordings, sensor outputs or Fuel-hosted assets, or about migrating away. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that SDFormat is an open, vendor-neutral standard; any export or bulk-download path for logs, recorded data and Fuel assets; independent corroboration of portability to other tools.
